note: Copy to settings.json (setup.ps1 does it). Without settings.json CS2 is found through Steam and addon is mcp_lab. addon: the only CS2 addon this tool writes to. compile_threads 0 = all cores. blender: path to blender.exe ("" = search tools/, Steam libraries, Program Files). backups_dir: map copies and sources snapshots ("" = <project>/backups; best on another disk or in a synced folder such as OneDrive, e.g. "D:\\Backups\\cs2map"). backup_sources: more folders to snapshot besides my/ and the addon content. restart_hung_cs2: true lets the MCP restart CS2 Workshop Tools it launched itself (game_launch) when it stays "Not responding" for restart_hung_cs2_seconds (>= 60): kill, relaunch with this addon, reload the map, retry the call once. restart_hung_cs2_user: true also restarts a Workshop Tools session of this addon that the user started (for unattended sessions; refused while Hammer has unsaved edits); a plain game is never touched (setup.ps1 asks once). limits: disk caps; files named in README/docs/reports are never removed; map copies follow tiers (keep_last copies, hourly hours, daily days, weekly weeks) and caps in MB of compressed copies.
